q1_issues.issue: The parse asserts a completed past seeing event, but the text only says fog was the only thing *to be seen* (available to sight) — the potential/passive-infinitive modality is dropped, so an occurrence is asserted that the sentence never states.

The negative-existential frame "there was nothing ... but" is silently re-read as the focus particle "only", a mapping the instruction set does not license (its Only/Even/Also/Cleft list covers "only / just / solely" and clefts, not exceptive "but").

q2_gaps: exceptive "but" after a negative quantifier ("nothing but X", "no one but X") — no encoding is given for the negative-quantifier + exception construction
negative existential "there was nothing" — the "no/none" quantifier route needs a kind to attach strength 0.0 to, and a bare "nothing" supplies none
the potential passive infinitive "to be V-ed" ("nothing to be seen" = nothing visible) — no licensed carrier for the availability/possibility reading
notes: Roles are right for what was emitted: an agentless passive correctly omits the Experiencer and a perceived entity is Stimulus. The Only-tag reading is a reasonable improvisation, but the prejacent it asserts should be visibility, not an occurred seeing.
